subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hook names and payloads to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Code inspection proves the gap, but choosing hook names, payload shape, lazy enrichment, and cross-channel scope changes a public plugin API and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add reaction_added and reaction_removed as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for cross-channel parity.

options.title: Scope To Discord First
options.body: Accept a Discord-first contract now and require explicit follow-up so Slack, Matrix, and WhatsApp reaction payloads do not drift permanently.

options.title: Defer The API Surface
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events or external workarounds until maintainers are ready to sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add reaction_added and reaction_removed as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for cross-channel parity.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the public plugin hook contract, where this person has the strongest recent history signal among the likely owners.
